messages:
alex: CI red on hosted-integ - 8/45 failing across two shards, most are 'handshake timeout'. saw this start ~15:02 UTC. anyone oncall? link: https://ci.internal/runs/1759994319 :thinking:

deploy-bot: Test run 1759994319 finished: 37 passed, 8 failed (shards: 12,18). artifacts: https://ci.internal/artifacts/1759994319

priya: I saw a similar pattern yesterday — some 401s + handshake timeouts. can we grab a raw failing request + auth header? might be jwks rotation related.

jamal: can someone kick parallel reruns for shard 12 and 18? if it repros I'll bisect.

ci-runner: Reruns queued: shards 12 & 18. queued run ids: 1759994335, 1759994336. ETA ~2m.

lina: Quick checks to run on the runner while rerun happens:
```sh
# from a runner node
curl -v https://hosted-auth.internal/.well-known/jwks.json -o /tmp/jwks.json
jq . /tmp/jwks.json | head
# also: tcpdump filter to see 502/504 to auth svc
```

alex: grabbing logs from the failing container, small snippet:
```
[2025-10-07T15:02:14Z] WARN auth: jwks fetch failed status=502 err="upstream returned 502"
[2025-10-07T15:02:44Z] ERROR session: handshake timeout after 30s svc=hosted-api shard=12
```

priya: if jwks fetch is 502 we may have a brief window where new kid isn't in cache and tokens fail. fallback should accept tokens for a short TTL though. @sarah can you check the cache TTL change from yesterday?

sarah: looking. we merged a small change in PR #3421 yesterday that bumped jwks cache TTL to 5m -> 30s (intended) but it looks like a typo flipped the units back to 5s on prod. rolling a quick patch to restore 30s. will also check logs for 502s to the external jwks provider.

jamal: here's a redacted auth header from one failing request (from artifacts):
```
Authorization: Bearer <redacted-token>
Header: {"alg":"RS256","kid":"b1f3a9c4"}
```

alex: that kid matches a key we rotated this morning. artifact with request/headers attached: https://ci.internal/artifacts/1759994319/requests/47

sarah: good find. starting canary rollback on jwks-cache change on 2 canary nodes now. if rollback doesn't clear the 502->timeout chain we'll fallback to upstream jwks endpoint mirror.

deploy-bot: Canary patch scheduled: rollback jwks-cache-change -> nodes: canary-1, canary-2. patch id: patch-1759994342

priya: if rollback fixes it we should add a nightly smoke that rotates a test key and asserts tokens still accepted for 2m after rotation. i'll add it to the backlog.

lina: i'll own the postmortem and timeline. will collect logs + rerun artifacts. assigning to myself — will post draft.

jamal: thanks all, will watch reruns and start a bisect if failures persist.

alex: last rerun started 1759994360. leaving thread open until green. :white_check_mark:
